Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Karl Ludwig Pöllnitz (author, Wikidata Q92292), died 1775. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Pöllnitz, Karl Ludwig, Freiherr von, 1692-1775") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Memoirs of Charles-Lewis, Baron de Pöllnitz.: Being the Observations He Made in His Late ..., Printed for Daniel Browne, at the Black Swan, without Temple-Bar ., 1740, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/memoirscharlesl03whatgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 45%, 42%, 64% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Karl Ludwig Pöllnitz, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
